"""Exercises the candidate updater's complete source-authentication preparation."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys

root=Path.cwd()
scratch=Path('/tmp/aos-bazel-722')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools/bazel/metadata'))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate',scratch/'update_rust_optional_candidate.py')
updater=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(updater)
archives=json.loads((scratch/'cli-optional-archives.json').read_text())
previous=json.loads((scratch/'cli-optional-dependencies-candidate-validation.json').read_text())
results={}
for family in ['aos-cli-tests','aos-cli-fleet-tests','aos-cli-production']:
 directory=root/'third_party/rust'/family
 inventory=json.loads((directory/'sources.json').read_text())
 work=scratch/('cli-optional-full-source-prepare-'+family)
 work.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 staged=work/'staged'
 staged.mkdir()
 (work/'spliced').mkdir()
 shutil.copyfile(directory/'Cargo.lock',work/'spliced/Cargo.lock')
 shutil.copyfile(directory/'cargo-bazel.json',work/'context.json')
 shutil.copyfile(directory/'generator-config.json',work/'config.json')
 (work/'rendered').symlink_to(scratch/('cli-locked-feature-repair-'+family)/'raw')
 cache=work/'cargo-home/registry/cache/aos'
 cache.mkdir(parents=True)
 for repository,source in inventory['sources'].items():
  archive=Path(archives[family][repository])
  assert archive.is_file(),archive
  (cache/(source['name']+'-'+source['version']+'.crate')).symlink_to(archive)
 repository='aos_'+family.replace('-','_')+'_crates'
 sources=updater.prepare_sources(previous[family]['specification'],work,repository,staged)
 assert sources==inventory['sources'],family
 produced={path.name:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(staged.iterdir())}
 assert produced.keys()==inventory['generated_files'].keys(),family
 changes=sorted(name for name,digest in produced.items() if digest!=inventory['generated_files'][name])
 assert changes==previous[family]['changed_files'],(family,changes,previous[family]['changed_files'])
 results[family]={'status':'PASS','source_archives_authenticated':len(sources),'source_urls_hashes_and_license_domains_preserved':True,'changed_generated_files':changes,'staged':str(staged),'generated_files':produced}
 print(family,'PASS;',len(sources),'archives authenticated;',len(changes),'changed BUILD files',flush=True)
(scratch/'cli-optional-full-source-prepare-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
